notes: Four documents: two Honor Code advice pages, the model syllabus, and the AIPI report (187 units from A, 211 from B). Units were aligned by anchor and sentence span; 4 pairs that sat on adjacent but different sentences were split into unmatched units (so matched counts exclude them). Main disagreements: (1) actor on reported or rationale statements (A admin, B all; resolved to all unless a named office is addressed), research-use rules (A instructor, B all; resolved to all), sample tier labels (resolved to student/during-work since the label binds students), and the three-step honor-statement list (resolved to instructor, from the text 'They should then take steps to have students'); (2) unit_stance on training, disclosure, access and verification-checklist units (encourage, require or permit vs neutral; resolved to neutral because they take no position on using AI), and prohibit vs restrict for the Mason categories (graded-work ban is prohibit, brainstorming-only is restrict); (3) phase (stated goals general vs before-course; verification during-work); (4) modality where the text's own verb decides (must for 'must urge', should-not for 'should not input', should for recommendations in a report); (5) policy_type: P65 vs P92 (P65 for review roles, P92 for licensed tools), P62 for research rules vs P63/P65/P73, P52 for copyright vs P77 for FERPA/compliance, and UNCOVERED vs P83/P78 for sound judgment and student confirmation (P83 and P78 with fit notes); the absence-of-research-policy statement stays UNCOVERED like the other absence statement. Stance: A coded the two SARP advice pages restrict, B delegates; resolved to restrict because the pages fix the 'unauthorized unless permitted' fallback; the model syllabus and AIPI report are delegates in both (2 of 4 documents agree). Dropped only-A units (4): non-AI honor-code rationale in the model syllabus and three peer-institution descriptions in the AIPI appendices. Dropped only-B unit (1): a peer-trend line on detectors. All other single-coder units were checked against the text and kept.
